phase_0.boundary_condition: The universal categorical grammar boundary containing all catalog entries and their mathematical fragments.

VINIT.justification: The void before any organism entry is indexed or mapped.

TANCH.justification: The closed categorical tier that contains the system.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation that closes the gap between a primitive and its L8 target.

AREV.justification: The reverse evaluation that quantifies the residual gap from the L8 target.

CLINK.justification: The sequential composition of categorical fragments into a full CLINK expression.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential state that recognizes its own encoding.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits the organism entry into Promoted Atoms and Distant Fragments.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the complete CLINK L8 Organism expression from the promoted and distant branches.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where a fragment matches or promotes to the L8 target.

EVALF.justification: The negative state where a fragment remains distant and fails to promote.

ENGAGR.justification: A paradice holding both promoted and distant states simultaneously, as seen in Gödel or CTMU entries.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, append-only fixation of the finalized CL8NK entry.

phase_3.void_description: Unindexed catalog state, no entries loaded or mapped.
phase_3.true_description: Fragment successfully promoted to the CLINK L8 target with zero gap.
phase_3.false_description: Fragment remains distant, retaining a measurable promotion gap.
phase_3.both_description: Paradoxical or composite entity holding both promoted and distant states simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the empty CL8NK catalog void before any entries exist.
Load the self-modeling reference template for the CLINK L8 Organism.
Split the incoming organism entry into Promoted Atoms and Distant Fragments.
Apply the forward promotion morphism to close the gap on the T-arm.
Affirm the successful promotion of matched categorical fragments.
Measure the residual categorical distance on the F-arm.
Register the distant fragments that failed to reach the L8 target.
Reconstitute the complete organism entry from the promoted and distant branches.
Chain the recovered categorical fragments into the full CLINK expression.
Anchor the finalized entry to the CLINK L8 reference boundary.
Hold paradoxical composites in the B-state without resolving the contradiction.
Permanently record the mapped CL8NK entry in the append-only catalog.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The CL8NK Navigator parsing engine that translates domain concepts into operations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Categorical fragment alignment protocol for matching primitives to targets.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The CLINK L8 reference matrix storing the categorical skeleton.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Tier and distance sorting algorithm that orders entries by promotion gap.
phase_5.alfs_store: The universal catalog of organisms, ecosystems, and paradoxes.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Computational distance metric evaluation across the categorical skeleton.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Unindexed organism concept with undefined categorical tier.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Fully mapped CL8NK entry with explicit tier, match, and gap data.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The mapping preserves the categorical information exactly through Frobenius recovery.
